Container.Name: gambit
Container.Overview: gambit - the rule-builder / dry-run dashboard for an autonomous trading-research bot. Create paper accounts, attach trading rules, and watch positions, tax lots and simulated orders on a local SQLite ledger. It places NO orders anywhere: every write is to its own ledger. LOGIN: every page sits behind a Google sign-in that admits exactly ONE Google account (GAMBIT_ALLOWED_EMAIL); any other account gets "not authorized". It REFUSES TO START unless all five login-gate variables are set, and the container log names any that are missing. Create a Google OAuth 2.0 "Web application" client and register GAMBIT_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI on it exactly. SIGN-IN ONLY WORKS AT THAT URI'S HOST: Google accepts https on a real domain or localhost, never a bare LAN IP, so open the dashboard through that hostname (or http://localhost:8000 via a port-forward) rather than at the container's IP. The Data path holds gambit.db, the paper-trading ledger - back it up. Runs as uid 99, gid 100 (nobody:users).
Container.Description: gambit - rule-builder / dry-run dashboard (FastAPI), behind a single-account Google sign-in.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: App HTTP port. Put an https reverse proxy in front of it for a hostname Google will accept as the sign-in redirect.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds gambit.db, the paper-trading ledger (accounts, rules, simulated orders, tax lots). Append-only history with no re-importable source - losing it loses that history. The container runs as uid 99, gid 100 (nobody:users), what Unraid gives appdata; a directory owned otherwise must be made writable by 99:100. REQUIRED - an absolute path on a POOL.

Config.Name: GAMBIT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Client ID of your Google OAuth 2.0 client of type Web application (Google Cloud Console, Google Auth Platform, Clients). Not a secret.

Config.Name: GAMBIT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Client secret of the same Google OAuth client.

Config.Name: GAMBIT_SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: REQUIRED. At least 32 random characters; signs the sign-in session cookie. Changing it signs every session out, nothing else.

Config.Name: GAMBIT_ALLOWED_EMAIL
Config.Description: REQUIRED. The ONE Google account allowed past the sign-in (case-insensitive). Every other Google account is told it is not authorized. Changing it signs out any session issued to the previous address.

Config.Name: GAMBIT_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI
Config.Description: REQUIRED. The address Google sends the browser back to after sign-in, ending in /auth/callback - e.g. https://gambit.example.com/auth/callback, or http://localhost:8000/auth/callback when reached through a port-forward. Must be registered on the Google client EXACTLY, and the dashboard must be opened at this same host. https here also marks the cookies Secure.
